MEHLISSA Next M4.12 conservative terminal entity-ownership contract, version 1.0.0
sources.role: sampling, pending transfer, acknowledgement, and single-owner semantics

limitations: All outcome rates and therefore all sampled frequencies are synthetic software-test values without physiological interpretation.
Retention, adhesion, and extravasation are terminal in M4.12; detachment, remobilization, tissue motion, uptake, degradation, and return routes are not modeled.
The target compartments are abstract ownership labels and not anatomical geometry or cellular state.
A terminal store proves conservative ownership but is not yet an executable M5 tissue or cell model.
